title: Suspending or archiving a Space takes its website down on the next request

verify.note: Fails before the fix: setSpaceStatus never calls refreshSite.

detail: A Space website is cached under the tag site:<slug> and served from ISR. setSpaceStatus (staff suspend or archive, the moderation takedown) wrote spaces.status and repainted admin paths but never expired that tag, so the public site kept serving until the cache window ran out. The site reads getPublicSpaceBySlugOrThrow, which returns null for a non-active Space, so expiring the tag is the whole fix. Expected lift: a takedown is immediate, not minutes to an hour later. Other writers without a refresh (admin spaces/[id]/actions.ts, manage/modules, manage/mode, shop-actions, domain-purchase, space-beta-grant) are listed in the audit for a follow-up check of what each changes on the site.
